name: node-functions
description: Use this skill when a node's Python or JavaScript code calls a function Curio gives node code: loading a Data Catalog dataset, collection or file, loading or running a Model Catalog model, reading a saved key, writing a file the node returns, deriving a file from a collection's file, editing map features, or reading one layer of an input. It lists every curio_ function with the engines that have it and each argument, saying which arguments name a catalog's item.
